heroLead: Voyager Maps has 4,352 practical places mapped in Kyoto — the things you actually need while travelling, rather than restaurants and directions.

ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Kyoto on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Kyoto
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Kyoto it currently holds 604 public toilets and 192 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: Kyoto has 3.1 times more public toilets than places to refill a bottle — 604 against 192. Worth filling up before you set out.
